| Recommendation year | Open recommendations |

| 2024 | 4 |
| 2025 | 4 |
| 2026 | 44 |

*Recommendations that have been open for more than one year* are those issued in 2025 or earlier (2023 – 2025).  

**Open > 1 year:** 5 + 4 + 4 = **13**  

**Answer:** The OIT has **57 open recommendations**, of which **13 have been open for more than a year**.
